prompts.merchant: Create a production game sprite sheet for Ashen dark fantasy RPG. Reference input is STYLE AND CAMERA only: match its realistic hand-painted, muted low contrast adult NPC sprites, high three-quarter top-down camera showing top of head and shoulders, fully visible boots, ordinary face small and natural. NEW subject: one ordinary adult female traveling merchant, unglamorous everyday face, short tied brown hair, dull olive wool coat over tan linen shirt, plain russet skirt/trousers and worn brown boots, utilitarian leather waist belt with coin purse, two pouches and small crossbody goods satchel. No ornate noble gown, no jewelry, no makeup, no portrait photorealism. EXACT layout: 4 columns by 2 rows on a 1536x1024 transparent canvas, 8 equal 384x512 cells. Each cell one full body same woman, identical size and outfit, head to boots inside margins. Top row front three-quarter idle, front walk left step, front walk right step, side-facing right idle. Bottom row back three-quarter idle, back walk left step, back walk right step, side-facing left idle. Keep silhouette 300 pixels tall inside every cell, centred horizontally with boot soles at 460 pixels within each cell; plenty of fully transparent gutters. No portraits, no scenery, no text, no cell borders, no painted ground shadow, no glow or backdrop whatsoever. Authentic transparent alpha pixels around all figures. Preserve consistent lighting, restrained painted texture, game camera and anatomy from reference.

Each icon is a visibly different object, not a recolor. VIEW: three-quarter inventory object, no body or mannequin. Row 3: (1) simple brown leather hood (2) ash-grey angular assassin hood (3) plain steel enclosed knight helmet (4) spiked dark iron crown (5) blue embroidered mage hood (6) lantern-shaped golden circlet (7) white fur-trimmed hood (8) raven beak knight helmet. Row 4: (1) stitched brown traveling leather vest with straps (2) black layered assassin coat with asymmetric shoulder (3) plain steel knight breastplate (4) silver blue overlapping scale mail (5) blue mage long robe with gold runes (6) black heavy executioner armor with pointed shoulders (7) bone-ribbed dark leather armor (8) raven feather mantle over dark metal armor. Row 5: (1) leather flame-stitched wrist guards, pair (2) black steel lightning gauntlets, pair (3) silver segmented knight gauntlets, pair (4) embroidered midnight mage gloves, pair (5) wing-buckled light leather boots, pair (6) split-toed dark rogue boots, pair (7) iron plated heavy knight boots, pair (8) blue cloth fur-cuff mage boots, pair. Transparent background is essential; each cell's outer 10% must be empty. Keep exact grid and row category ordering. No overlapping adjacent cells.
